snippet.title: IORETIN | New Survival Horror Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336160/IORETIN/

A short horror experience inspired by PS2 classics, set in a Brazilian coastal town. Step into the shoes of a young fisherman trying to survive the horrors that emerged from the depths of Guanabara Bay while searching for news of his brother, trapped offshore in the once peaceful town of IORETIN.

IORETIN is a Survival Horror game made by Hex Frog Games.

Wishlist it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336160/IORETIN/
